**Screen: vendor-signup-390 (390px)**
- Subtitle copy mismatch: Design reads “Register with Peptrace to build client trust.”; preview renders the longer desktop string “Register your business with Peptrace and build customer trust.”
- Agreement checkbox copy mismatch: Design reads “Agree to the Partner Service Terms *”; preview renders “I confirm I am authorized to represent this vendor and agree to the Partner Service Terms *”.
- CTA button copy mismatch: Design reads “Continue — $279/mo”; preview reads “Continue to Payment — $279/mo”.
- Premium upgrade panel: Preview shows a small decorative icon (sparkle/star) to the left of the panel text that is absent in the design.
- Premium price pill: Preview includes a small downward chevron/arrow inside the “$279/month” pill; the design shows a plain pill without a chevron.
- Footer link vertical spacing: Footer anchor links in the preview are stacked more tightly than in the design (current spacing is visibly smaller than the design’s looser line-height/gap).

**Screen: iPad-VendorSignUp (744px)**
- Design and preview images could not be downloaded; visual comparison was skipped for this breakpoint.

**Screen: vendor-signup-1440 (1440px)**
- Premium upgrade panel: Same extra decorative icon to the left of the panel text as seen on mobile.
- Premium price pill: Same extra downward chevron inside the “$279/month” pill as seen on mobile.
- Footer link vertical spacing: Footer links have tighter vertical spacing compared to the design; the design uses a slightly larger line-height or margin between items.
- Otherwise the desktop layout, header, form card width/padding, and three-column footer alignment closely match the design.
